        <h2>MuJoCo Models</h2>
        <p style="margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-dark);">
          Physics-based simulations using MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) for biomechanical 
          analysis, including golf swing models, pendulum systems, and multibody dynamics simulations. 
          MuJoCo provides fast and accurate physics simulation for model-based optimization and analysis.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="article-category">
        <h2>Available Models</h2>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Golf Swing Biomechanics Model</h3>
          <p>Full-body golf swing model with realistic biomechanics, including joint constraints, 
          muscle activation, and contact dynamics. Suitable for optimization and control analysis.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Pendulum Systems</h3>
          <p>Various pendulum configurations implemented in MuJoCo, including single, double, and 
          multi-link pendulums with different actuation schemes and constraints.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="article-card">
          <h3>Multibody Dynamics Models</h3>
          <p>General multibody dynamics models for analyzing control-affine systems, including 
          underactuated systems and systems with constraints.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
